facts.raw_span: A 54-year-old man with glioblastoma
treated by surgical resection
began a clinical trial with M7824
a severely pruritic, nontender, erythematous papular and macular eruption
on his back, bilateral ankles, and upper extremities
no elevations in liver enzymes
no eosinophilia
no lymphadenopathy
the eruption represented a drug reaction to M7824
the rash and pruritus progressed
the rash reached grade II severity
the rash progressed to grade III with worsening pruritus
